name: Abulia
detailed_description:
Abulia is an Type-battle System RPG and Visual Novel adventure that takes place on mind of a special girl that is trying to find herself in the world and struggling to understand our complex world.

Gameplay

You are trapped in your room, days and time will pass by and you need to escape before falling into madness. interact with the different elements inside to discover how to do it:

  • Type-writing Mental Battles: Depending on the decisions taken our protagonist will get mentally exhausted, once the gauge is filled she will have a MENTAL BREAKDOWN. This will turn into either memories to be collected or enter a battle against ghosts.

    In mental battles you will be presented with different words, type out those marked in blue and avoid typing those in red. If you get it right you will get the ghost's sympathy and your mind will calm. Otherwise you will make it angry and you will be eaten by your thoughts, ending the game.

  • Collectible cards: There are up to 30 cards to collect around the whole game and will be obtained triggering different events.

  • Emotional stats will affect your performance in battle and events in history.

    If you lose against your inner demons you lose the game

Door: If you manage to take the door you will escape.

Features

  • 30 cards / memories to unlock

  • 30 Ghosts to fight against

  • 5 Bosses

  • Different emotional states

Story

Carla has been trapped for who knows how many days inside her room, one day she wakes up and finds a huge eye that watches over. Worse than that, her room's door now seems to be cursed.

Find out her inner struggles while you play!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core from Intel or AMD at 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 capable GPU or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 or any 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Dual-core from Intel or AMD at 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 capable GPU or higher
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA or PulseAudio-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Ensure necessary 64-bit libraries are installed.
